digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design documentation must be added at named anchors without new gate machinery to address parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, oracle upgrade gate findings, and known residual gaps.
Surface-parity census in SKILL.md §4a must enumerate CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, and dual-direction slots with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason dispositions.
Test-design.md §6 must specify config-effect contrast tests proving each config key changes behavior through real read path, not merely parsing.

SKILL.md §4b contention triggers must route composed/check-then-act writes to test_concurrency_regression.py, write-storm/retry-reclamation to test_store_concurrency.py, and read-integrity-under-contention to sync_contention_harness.py by shape.
Behavioral gate findings must receive RED tests first in the same change before fix; non-behavioral findings may be fixed directly and exempted from change-detector tests.
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep must enumerate out-of-scope census slots, exclusions, compromises, and deferred advisories as filed/accepted-with-reason/fixed with forced-artifact wording.
